mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 58 degrees and an air quality index of 51 under a full moon.

The Planning Department is alerting residents to be wary of scammers requesting application fee payments via wire transfer or suspicious websites. Also, public works crews are preparing for fall leaf pickup which begins October 5.
There is plenty to do with Live Music at Bailey's Run and the Verona Fall Fest both happening today. Tomorrow, you can catch the Dane County Farmer's Market or live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy call from September 5, Verona officers responded to reports of vehicles with cheese slices on their windshields, identifying it as a viral social media prank known as the Dairy Dare.
Culver's is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM with their flavor of the day.
